howItWorks.title: How It Works
howItWorks.subtitle: Three simple steps to lace-free shoes
howItWorks.step1Desc: Attach the EasyLaces clip to your shoe — fits any shoe type instantly.
howItWorks.step2Desc: Pull the laces through and lock them in place with a satisfying click.
howItWorks.step3Desc: No knots, no hassle. Your shoes are secure and ready to go.

features.title: Why EasyLaces?
features.subtitle: Designed for comfort, built to last
features.ecoDesc: Made from recyclable, biodegradable PLA+ material — safe for everyday use.
features.craftedDesc: Each clip is individually crafted and hand-finished for consistent quality and a perfect fit.
features.durableDesc: Strong enough for daily wear, yet light and comfortable on any shoe.
features.heatDesc: Maintains shape and durability up to 60 °C (140 °F).
features.fitDesc: Designed for laces 6–7 mm wide and up to 2 mm thick — fits most sneakers and sports shoes.
features.fitTip: Tip: Some lace tips may be slightly thicker. Gently press with pliers for a smooth fit through the clip.
